author: Thagendra Bastola
review_text: eSewa has many issues these days. The SMS login code takes a long time to arrive or sometimes doesn’t come at all. Every time I try to log in, it cuts my SIM balance, which is really frustrating. It shouldn’t charge users just to receive a login code. Please fix this problem and improve the login system so users can log in easily without losing balance.
